column1: # The food behind every shipped article (ticket 288). One article per line, fields separated by "|":
# article key (internal/library/articles.txt) | food id | grams of one piece | grams per millilitre
# Food id: "bls:<BLS code>" or "usda:<FDC id>" of a food in foods.tsv.gz. Every article that is food has one;
# articles that are not food (kind nonfood) have none. The food is the plain, raw or ready-to-eat one a recipe
# means (flour is the flour, tea and coffee are the brewed drink).
# Piece column "-": no weight or spoon counts for the article (tea, coffee, coffee beans: grams of leaves or beans are
# not the brewed drink), the recipe lists the line as not counted. Tea and coffee keep a density, so ml of the brewed
# drink counts; coffee beans have none, so nothing of them counts.
# Grams of one piece: the edible weight of one "Stück" (empty: Hejmo does not know one, a recipe in Stück then
# says the line is not counted). Grams per millilitre: the density (empty: not known); it turns ml, l, EL, TL and
# Prise into grams. Both are guide values for a household kitchen, never a promise.
